Aabiding dagwaagig, gaa-gwiinawi-izhichigewaad igiweg awesiiyensag, gaa-izhi-naanaaganawendamowaad, gaa-izhi-giigidod awe Migiziins, "O-atawaadaanig igiweg awakaanag mii imaa gichi-bikwaakwad."
Naa mii sa geget gaa-jiikendamowaad aya'aag Makoons, Nigigoons, Waaboozoons, miinawaa Ajijaakoons.
"Ahaw waabang giga-izhaamin iwidi", ikido awe Migiziins.
Apaakwa'amowaad imaa megweyaakwaang iwidi debaabandamowaad i'iwe endazhi-ganawenimindwaa igiweg awakaanag.
"Ahaw" ikidowag Makoons, Nigigoons, Waaboozoons, miinawaa Ajijaakoons.
Mii aya'aag Bizhikiins, Maanishtaanish, Maanadikoons, Naabeseyens, Animoons nakweshkaagowaad, "Aaniindish omaa ba-inanokiiyeg," ikido awe Naabeseyens.
Giinawaa idash, ge-ganawendang iwe minik ge-gabenaadiyang.
Mii zhigwa a'aw Agongosens bi-ombiwebinige gichi-bikwaakwad.
Mii ombigwaashkwaniwaad Ajijaakoons miinawaa Bizhikiins azhigwa gii-maadataadiwaad.
Awakaanag igiweg nitam gaa-tebibidoowaad iwe gichi-bikwaakwad.
Mii awe Maanishtaanish gaa-pimiwidood gwaakwaashkwesidood, ogii-apagidamowaan gichi-bikwaakwad iniw Maanadikoshensan, miinawaa Naabesensan.
Mii azhe-webinamowaad iniwen Maanadikoshensan, apagidamowaad iwidi iniw Animoonsan.
Gii-ni-maajibatood ani-gwaakwaashkwesidood, miinawaa ge-ani-gwaashkwanid, gagwe-biinjwebinige i'iw chi-bikwaakwad.
Mii dash imaa gii-nawadinang chi-bikwaakwad a'awe Ajijaakoons.
Iwidi gii-izhi-apagidamowaad iniw Waaboozoonsan ge-wiin miinawaa gaa-apagidinigod iniw Nigigoonsan miinawaa Makoonsan.
Mii awe gaa-ombiwebinang gii-onjwebiniged, gagwe-biinjwebiniged gaa-izhi-bishigowebiniged gaye wiin.
Nawaj igo gii-misizoonziwi awe Makoons, nawaj igo ani-nichiiwibizod awe Makoons imaa endanataadiwaad.
Gaa-izhi-debibidood gichi-bikwaakwad awe Bizhikiins, gaa-izhi-apagidamowaad iniw Maanishtaanishensan.
Mii miinawaa iwidi Animoons miinawaa Naabesensan, miinawaa awedi Maanadikoshensan iwidi gaye Maanishtaanishensan mii awe gaa-ombiwebinang naana'idaa biinjibidenig mii awe niizh ayaamowaad.
Waaboozoons ogii-piindigewebinaan iniw Nigigoonsan awe gaa-maajiidood gwaashkwaashkwesidood gii-aazhawiwidood, midaaso-biisi-diba'igaans beshibii'igaadenig.

Mii miinawaa gaa-pagidamowaad Makoonsan, azhe-webinamowaad iniwen Migiziinsan miinawaa awedi Waaboozoonsan mii awe azhe-webinamowaad Migiziinsan gaa-izhi-waabamaad nazhikegaabawinid Nigigoonsan gii-piinjwebinang gaa-izhi-bitaganaamind, mii dash awe Agongosens gii-noondaagwichiged gii-miinaad niizh anishaa ji-biinjwebinigenid.
Naa sa go geget gaa-izhi-ombiwebinang ogii-bishigowebinaan idash awe dash gaa-izhi-aanjiwebinang, mii dash gaa-piinjwebinang.
Mii iwe zhigwa Awesiiyensag niigaaniwaad niswi mii dash Awakaanag niizh.
Mii owe zhigwa aabitawayi'ii giizhiikamowaad jibwaa-aabitaa-anwebiwaad, aya'aa Awakaanag ashi-naanan odayaanaawaa Awesiiyensag idash ashi-bezhig.
Mii zhigwa geget ayaangwaamigwiikaazod a'awe Ajijaakoons igaye Awesiiyensag.
Mii azhigwa gaye geget maajii-nichiiwibizod a'awe Makoons, enigok odaminod mii iniwen eniwenimigod Bizhikiinsan.
Naabesens gaye wiin gagwe-ayaangwaamizid, "Gaawiin indaa-inenimigosiimin eta go," enendang.
Makoons obiindigewebinamowaan iniw Waaboozoonsan gaa-pi-maajiidood gaa-apagidamowaad Nigigoonsan miinawaa awedi Makoons, iwidi gaye Waaboozoonsan.
Mii zhigwa gii-niigaaniiwaad Awesiiyensag niizhtana ashi bezhig miinawaa ashi-zhaangaso Awakaanag.

Mii iw Bizhikiins biindigewebinamowaad iniw Maanishtaanishensan iniw Animoonsan azhe-webinamowaad iniw Maanishtaanishensan, miinawaa Animoonsan gaa-izhi-mitinind michibatwaadang bikwaakwad awe Animoons.
Mii imaa Agongosens gii-saagijiwidood ininamowaad iwe bikwaakwad Nigigoonsan gaa-piindigewebinamowaad iniw Waaboozoonsan, Migiziinsan gii-apagidamowaad.
Miinawaa awedi Makoonsan imaa aya'ii nawayi'ii ani-maajiibatwaadang ani-gwaakwaashkwesidood gii-ani-biinjwebinang.
Mii zhigwa biindigewebinang Maanadikoshens gaa-izhi-biindigewebinang Maanishtaanishensan awe gaa-ani-azhewidood imaa midaaso-biisi-diba'igaans beshibii'igaadeg.
Iwidi gii-apagidamowaad awedi Bizhikiins, Animoons, Maanadikoshens, Naabesens, Maanishtaanishens ombiwebinang, bishigowebinige.
Ajijaakoons ogii-tebibidoon apagidamowaad iniw Migiziinsan apagidamowaad iniw Waaboozoonsan, Ajijaakoons, Migiziins, Nigigoons, Makoons.
Mii awe gaa-michibatwaadang gaa-miinindwaa owe bikwaakwad ji-biindigewebinamowaad awe Maanishtaanishens apagidamowaad Maanadikoshensan.
Gii-aazhawiwidood imaa beshibii'igaadenig, waabamaad iwidi Bizhikiinsan nazhikegaabawinid enigok epagidamowaad gaa-izhi-bishigobidood awe Bizhikiins.
Miinawaa ogii-tebibidoon awe Agongosens, miinaad iniw Waaboozoonsan.
Mii azhigwa Waaboozoons apagidamowaad iniw Nigigoonsan, Makoons, Nigigoons, Waaboozoons, Migiziins, mii gaa-izhi-gojiwebinang, gii-piinjwebinang niswi inagindenig.
Mii igo niizhtana ashi ningodwaasi Awesiiyensag ashi-zhaangaso Awakaanag.

Mii imaa biindigewebinamowaad Awakaanag, nawaj igo Naabesens gaa-aazhawiwidood imaa beshibii'igaadenig weweni go gii-gwaashkwaakwesidood gezikaa imaa maajibatwaadang gaa-ani-gwaashkwesidood imaa dawaanig gii-ni-biinjwebinang.
Miinawaa gaa-biindigewebinamowaad Waaboozoons, Nigigoons, Migiziins, Makoons.
Bezhigwanong niibawi gwaashkwaakwesidood apagidamowaad enigok Ajijaakoonsan gaa-ni-biinjwebinang.
Makoons niizhing gii-maazhichige Ajijaakoons aabiding gii-maazhichige.
Maanadikoshens aabiding gii-maazhichige, Maanishtaanish aabiding, Bizhikiins niizhing.
Mii go iw aa'aazhook gaa-izhi-kodaadiwaad iwe azhigwa gii-aabitooseg idash ji-anwebiwaad ashi-naano-diba'igaans ji-anwebiwaad.
Awesiiyensag niizhtana ashi naanan Awakaanag niizhtana ashi bezhig.
Mii iw zhigwa miinawaa ozhigaabawiwaad ji-maajitaadiwaad.
Agongosens ombiwebinang miinawaa, enaasamigaabawitaadiwaad Ajijaakoons miinawaa Bizhikiins.
Mii go miinawaa naasaab Awakaanag gaa-tebibidoowaad awe Animoons aazhawiwidood beshibii'igaadenig.
Gii-maaminonaabamaad Bizhikiinsan anzhikegaabawinid apagidamowaad gii-ni-biinjwebinang Bizhikiins.
Awesiiyensag niizhtana ashi naanan Awakaanag niizhtana ashi niswi.
Awesiiyensag niimidana ashi bezhig, Awakaanag nisimidana ashi zhaangaso.
Geyaabi ingo-diba'igaans miish geget Makoons maajii-nichiiwibizod gaawiin obizikendanziin niiwing gii-maazhichiged.
Mii go gegaa go geyaabi niizhtana ashi bezhig ji-ataadiwaad imaa detebibidood bikwaakwad awe Bizhikiins.
Mii go omaa gaa-onji-webinang beshibii'igaadenig "Hay"' mii bishigowebinang ogii-nawadinaan Makoons igiw Awesiiyensag dibaabamaad iniw diba'igiiziswaanan.
Imaa gii-ayazhe-webinamaadiwaad iwidi Nigigoons Migiziins, Ajijaakoons, Waaboozoons, Makoons.
Mii imaa gii-poodaadiwaad noondaagochigan a'awe Agongosens.
Minik eyaamowaad Awesiiyensag niimidano ashi bezhig Awakaanag nisimidano ashi zhaangaso.
Mii zhigwa gii-naazikodaadiwaad ogoweg Awesiiyensag miinawaa Awakaanag gaa-giikinjigwenidiwaad miinawaa gaa-zazagininjiinindiwaad.
Mii sa iw gaa-ikidod awe Migiziins, "Gii-waabandamaang omaa ayaayeg moowikaamigak, gaawiin niinawind izhinaagwasinoon iwidi bi-onjibaayaang."
Ogii-piindaakoonaawaan ogimaa-nookweziganan ji-mamoowaad bakaan iwe nookwezigan gaa-ishkwaa-biindaakoonamowaawaad.
Gego giin wiikobidooken iniw nookweziganan imaa ojiibikaaning."
Wiinge Makoons gii-chiikendam gii-gikina'amawind gwayak ge-izhi-mamood iniw nookweziganan.
